raw_text: Student protests against quota system gain momentum in Dhaka. Thousands of university students took to the streets of Dhaka on Monday demanding reform of Bangladesh's controversial quota system for government jobs. The protests, which began at Dhaka University, quickly spread to other campuses across the capital. Students say the system, which reserves 56% of public sector jobs for various categories including freedom fighter descendants, is discriminatory against merit-based candidates. Police deployed water cannons near the Parliament building. Student leaders warned of escalation if demands are not met within 48 hours. Internet speeds were reportedly throttled in university areas.
